description: The frames of eac3-signal-spx 18 dB quieter (so that the gain of a decoder's RF mode stays under full scale) with compre set and a compr word that is +6.02 dB (0x10) in the first six frames and -6.02 dB (0xF0) in the last six, dialnorm 27 (A/52 5.4.2.9, 5.4.2.10 and 7.7.2): to see whether a decoder that picks its output mode by the presence of compr changes its gain at the step.

skip.skip_insertion: The check rewrites E-AC-3 frames with skip fields.
